extracted.summary: A solicitor asks whether funding of £34,000 is available for a client's financial remedy case at the Family Court at Manchester, where the only asset is a flat with about £27,000 equity.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for your client's financial remedy proceedings at the Family Court at Manchester. We have noted the £34,000 requested and the approximately £27,000 of equity in the flat. To take this further we would need the date of the next hearing, a costs estimate to final hearing, confirmation of the client's details and consent, details of the property including title and any charges, and a fuller picture of the other assets and liabilities. Once we have those we will review the enquiry and come back to you.
